testimonials.text: “Building products in a large organization can be a very lengthy and expensive process. With Radian we were able to cut our development costs and time by more than 60%, which allowed our team to develop very high quality digital experiences.”
testimonials.author: Nick Bayer

testimonials.text: “The speed at which our design systems engineering team now ships production features has doubled. Radian's component tokens and architecture are unmatched in simplicity and power.”
testimonials.author: Sarah Jenkins

testimonials.text: “We replaced our legacy UI foundation with Radian across six enterprise customer-facing dashboards. Zero downtime, zero regressions, and our users love the refreshed aesthetic.”
testimonials.author: Marcus Vance

testimonials.text: “Radian bridged the gap between our product design specs and frontend deliverables. What used to take two sprint cycles is now deployed in two days.”
testimonials.author: Elena Rostova
